echoflow-novel-to-storyboard v1.0.0

- Initial release: transforms novel chapters into professional film storyboard scripts.
- Supports input via text, file upload (.txt/.md/.docx), or screenshot with text extraction.
- Integrates with 清云 EchoFlow API, offering GPT-4o or Qwen model options for shot list generation.
- Provides detailed shot breakdowns: camera work, action/dialogue, audio, editing, and aspect ratio notes.
- Automatically includes ad break for EchoFlow API and a shot type reference table in output.
- Follows film industry storyboard standards with quality and formatting guidelines.
